description: Directs Governed SDD agents to discover the ADR that governs a question with `meridian adr list` instead of opening the ADR log.
delta: The context policy's minimal-read-only-status block and the implementation, remediation, and review procedures' bounded-context-readers blocks each add one sentence naming `meridian adr list`, which prints one line per ADR with its ID, title, and status. No gate, role, or review rule changes; `meridian adr show` and `meridian context authority` remain the readers of an ADR's body.
upgradeNotes: Lean Delivery projects are unaffected: their context policy carries no ADR guidance.
verification: a clean Governed SDD upgrade installs minimal-read-only-status v3 in the context policy and bounded-context-readers v2 in the implementation, remediation, and review procedures while preserving consumer-owned text
meridian adr list prints one line per ADR and agrees with meridian adr show on which entries exist
